{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash --login

# Flux batch script
#
# This is a self-submitting Flux script: run it directly (e.g., `./rm_deepspeed.flux.sh`).
# It will submit itself to Flux with the translated resource requests.

# Translated resources from Slurm:
#   -n 8            -> -n 8
#   --gres=gpu:2    -> -g 2
#   --time=06:00:00 -> -t 6h
JOBID=$(flux batch -N 1 -n 8 -g 2 -t 6h --wrap "bash --login $0 __flux_inner")

echo "Submitted Flux job: $JOBID"

if [ "${1:-}" = "__flux_inner" ]; then
  # NOTE: Slurm -J RM not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: job identification may be less convenient; runtime performance is unaffected.

  # NOTE: Slurm -o o.%x.%j / -e e.%x.%j use %x/%j expansions which Flux does not provide portably.
  # Performance implication: none; operational implication: log filenames may not be unique unless you add uniqueness.

  # NOTE: Slurm -p gpu_v100 not translated.
  # Performance implication: without a queue/constraint mapping, the job may run on any eligible GPU resources; you are not forcing v100 partition/constraint.

  # NOTE: Slurm --account=scw2050 not translated.
  # Performance/ops implication: accounting/charging may not be applied as intended; site may require account/project out-of-band.

  git pull origin dev-train
  module purge
  module load deepspeed
  module list

  export PYTHONPATH="${PYTHONPATH}:/home/c.scmse/Funtuner"

  # Run within the allocation.
  flux run -n 8 -g 2 singularity exec --nv "$DEEPSPEED_IMAGE" \
    /nfshome/store03/users/c.scmse/venv/bin/python3 funtuner/trainer.py
fi
"
}
